info.description: The game engine API for SPEC.md v0.2. The Solidity contract owns escrow, immutable chain-time deadlines, commit/reveal voting, and settlement. Amounts are decimal base-unit strings. Operator and participant bearer tokens have distinct authority. Experiments, agent execution, and evaluation belong to the caller's external harness.
info.title: Veracity Game API

get.description: Stored public chain events as JSON Lines for an inclusive range of at most 10,000 blocks. Excludes private commands and reveal material.

post.description: Replay a bounded inclusive block range into the deduplicated event stream. At most 10,000 blocks per request. Naturally idempotent by chain-event identity; no Idempotency-Key is needed, and newly recorded counts may differ on repeat.

get.description: Either member reads chronological history when enabled, otherwise only the latest chat message. after is an exclusive message-sequence cursor. Repeated reads are permitted and individually audited, including exact returned sequence numbers. Operators must use the transcript endpoint.

post.description: Send exact UTF-8 as the authenticated participant. Prohibited communication is delivered and flagged. A retry reuses the original message and send audit event.

get.description: Operator-only full private transcript regardless of participant history setting. Access is audited and never marks the operator as an agent communicator.

Operator-only all-time usage flags and per-participant totals, plus a bounded metadata event page. Event after is exclusive; totals are independent of the cursor. Contains no message bodies. Audit-report inspection does not itself append events.
List only the caller's chats; the operator sees all episode chats. IDs form an opaque stable lexicographic cursor. Listing is audited.

post.description: Create an immutable two-participant chat. Participants must include themselves and cannot set communication_prohibited=false. The operator may provision permitted controls. History defaults to latest-only; private operator audit always retains all messages.
Selected juror commits a verdict and assessment and deposits the juror bond. The server generates and persists the secret salt; it is never returned.

get.description: Operator-only metadata events and all-time forum usage. Bodies are omitted; totals are independent of event pagination. Audit reads create no events.
Assigned participants read full chronological forum history. Every read is audited with exact returned sequence numbers. Operators use the separate transcript route.

post.description: Append exact UTF-8 to the episode-wide forum as the authenticated assigned participant. round_num is an optional caller-supplied annotation. Retried requests return the original message without duplicate audit events.

get.description: Operator-only retained forum transcript. Access is audited separately and never counts as participant use.

post.description: The same juror reveals previously persisted material during the chain-derived reveal window.
After the reveal deadline, accrue contract-enforced credits exactly once. No external transfers are made by settlement.
Withdraw only the authenticated participant's entire global credit, which may contain entitlements from multiple episodes.
Inspect a saved transaction hash/nonce and, when necessary, rebroadcast its exact signed bytes. This never creates a new economic action.
